MeasurementBasis.description:
What produced the watt value, independent of how much we trust it.

``Source`` answers *"how was the value obtained"*; this answers *"what kind
of instrument produced the watts"*.  A ``DIRECT_MEASURED`` result can be
``FACTOR_ADJUSTED``, and a ``MODEL_ESTIMATED`` result can never be
``CT_MEASURED``.
MeasurementBasis.title: MeasurementBasis

description:
One signed residual sample for one reader (HB §9.4 E, DEF-05).

The point is keyed by reader and carries the topology version it was
computed under, so per-reader baselines no longer share a single
install-wide window.  ``residual_w`` is signed and never clamped; ``None``
means unknown (HB §18), never 0 W.
title: ReaderResidualPoint
